tools.name: check_domain_email_security
tools.description: Free. Look up a domain's MX, SPF (record, DNS lookup count, all qualifier), DMARC (policy, rua) and DKIM (common selectors, key size) from live DNS and list issues. No payment.

tools.name: pricing
tools.description: Free. Prices of the paid tools, payment network and receiving address.

tools.name: email_security_score
tools.description: Grade a domain's email security 0-100 (A-F): SPF 30, DMARC 40, DKIM 25, MX 5, from live DNS, with findings and the top 3 fixes. Read-only. Costs $0.01 USDC via x402; errors are not charged.

tools.name: check_email_address
tools.description: Check one email address: syntax, MX / null MX, disposable domain, role account, free provider; verdict ok / risky / undeliverable. No SMTP probe. Costs $0.01 USDC via x402; errors are not charged.

tools.name: email_fix_plan
tools.description: Email security fix plan for one domain: the exact SPF, DKIM and DMARC records to publish (create / replace / keep, name, value, why), in order, with click-path steps for the domain's DNS host and a staged DMARC rollout. Non-sending domains get a lock-down set. Costs $1 USDC via x402; errors are not

tools.name: bulk_email_security_score
tools.description: Score up to 100 domains' email security in one call (SPF 30, DMARC 40, DKIM 25, MX 5 from live DNS): per-domain score, grade and issues, plus a summary with grade counts, domains missing DMARC or SPF, and the worst 10. For MSPs and agents checking a client or vendor list. Costs $0.50 USDC via x402;

tools.name: watch_status
tools.description: Free. Status of a paid email setup watch (created with POST /v1/watch): items, expiry, last check, last webhook delivery and current SPF/DMARC/DKIM/MX state.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_domain_email_security, email_security_score, check_email_address, email_fix_plan, bulk_email_security_score, watch_status · Private data: check_domain_email_security, email_fix_plan · Public sink: check_domain_email_security, email_security_score, check_email_address, email_fix_plan, bulk_email_security_score, watch_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_domain_email_security, email_security_score, check_email_address, email_fix_plan, bulk_email_security_score, watch_status · Private data: check_domain_email_security, email_fix_plan · Public sink: check_domain_email_security, email_security_score, check_email_address, email_fix_plan, bulk_email_security_score, watch_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
